notes.title: Version 1.01 hotfix
notes.content:
This hotfix addressing the following issues:
-Fixed a bug that caused Tartarus mode to be unlocked from a new save
-Fixed a bug where entities would remain on the screen after a shop
-Fixed an issue with shop prices not resetting when starting a new game
-Fixed a potential crash related to disappearing entities
Thank you for your patience while I squash these bug.  Happy gaming!🎮

notes.title: Charon's Crossing 1.0 Update is Live!
notes.content:
[b]Update v1.0 - Unleash the Underworld![/b]

I'm thrilled to introduce Charon's Crossing version 1.0, a massive update that takes your journey through the Underworld to a whole new level. Get ready for some exciting additions:

🖼️ Stunning Border Artwork:
Marvel at the intricate border art that now tracks hazards in your current level and showcases your powerups. It's a visual treat that adds depth to your adventure.

🕹️ Enhanced Controls:
Taking control has never been easier. Pause the game with any key, and resume straight from where you left off. ESC while paused? Back to the menu you go.

🏞️ Return to Menu Anytime:
Feel like taking a break from the underworld? You can now return to the menu at any time and pick up your journey right where you left off.

🌒 Atmospheric Pausing:
Pause the game, and the screen dims as the music hushes, immersing you further into the game's eerie atmosphere.

🎚️ Progress Bar Upgrade:
Enjoy a smoother and more engaging progression experience with our revamped progress bar for levels.

🚪 Exit Game Option:
Whether you're celebrating victory or facing defeat, you can now exit the game directly from the game over and victory screens.

⌨️ Improved Keyboard Navigation:
Navigate through all menus seamlessly with keyboard functionality for a more efficient gaming experience.

🐛 Bug Fixes and Polish:
I've squashed some pesky bugs and polished up the game for a smoother, more enjoyable experience.

💰 Obol Adjustments:
Prices and drop rates for obols have been fine-tuned for a more strategic gameplay.

🏅 New Achievements:
Test your skills with twelve new achievements, and prove your mastery of the Underworld.

🎵 Fresh Music Tracks:
Enjoy three new music tracks that deepen the game's immersive soundtrack.

🎨 Updated Sprites:
Various sprites have been refreshed, adding a touch of newness to your adventure.

🏺 New Artifacts:
Hunt for five new artifacts, each with a unique source. Collect them all, or conquer the game, and you'll unlock the thrilling 'Tartarus' game mode.

🌌 Introducing Tartarus:
Dive into the endless challenge of Tartarus, where every run is different. Face random foes and new trials. Plus, meet two new allies - Thanatos and Hades - who act as merchants with distinct offerings.

⚙️Your settings are now saved between runs, ensuring a personalized gaming experience.

Get ready to explore the depths of the Underworld like never before in Charon's Crossing 1.0! Thank you for being part of this incredible adventure.

Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: Version 0.17 released
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.17 is Here![/b]

I'm excited to roll out the latest update for Charon's Crossing (v0.17), just in time for Halloween! This update brings some significant improvements and enhancements:

[list]
[*] 🏆 Fifteen new achievements, including three hidden challenges.
[*] ⏲️ Reduced spawn times for souls in many levels to keep things engaging.
[*] 🎨 Updated some entity graphics to freshen up your gaming experience.
[*] 💰 A few tweaks to shop prices for better strategy.
[/list]

Enjoy these improvements and continue your journey in the Underworld with Charon. Thanks for being part of the adventure!

Happy gaming!
